_doc: Real past oil/geopolitics headlines with the direction an oil trader expects (bullish = less supply or more risk, bearish = a deal, a reopening, an SPR release, an OPEC hike, neutral = no sign). Titles are copied from the live alerts file of 2026-11-05 (services/intel/evals/eval_headline_direction.EXPECTED_REAL), the headline_watch tests, services/intel/evals/labels_oil.json (Google News captures of 2026-10-17) and tests/fixtures/google_news_oil.xml. event_type is the Stage 2 class a desk trader would file it under; confirmed marks an explicit official confirmation in the title. Scored by services/intel/evals/eval_event_score.py.
